content.text:
`npm test` now passes, 2 of 2 tests.

**Wrong date:** `isoDate` in `lib/dates.js` was one month behind, because JavaScript counts months from 0. I added `+ 1` to the month, so 23 Oct 2026 now prints as `2026-10-23` instead of `2026-09-23`.

**Title:** In `reports/summary.js`, I changed `TITLE` from `"Resumen"` to `"Resumen diario"`.

**Heads-up:** `lib/dates.js` says it's used for every report and export, so this fix changes dates everywhere, not just in the daily summary. Until now, all those dates were a month early, and January dates came out with month `00`. If any saved files or other systems relied on the old dates, they'll need checking.

Nothing is committed yet.
